verdict.rationale: New Relic's public pricing page documents a self-serve perpetual free tier with 100 GB/month of ingest, and community posts mention a 'standard ingest rate'. That is some published, sales-free pricing, but no per-signal rates or cost-estimation material appear in the evidence. Community reports of default-on log collection and JFR raising ingest bills, and of pricing that 'baffled' users, suggest costs are hard to predict. missing for 10: published per-signal (logs/metrics/traces/events) price list, documented per-GB and per-user rates, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, independent confirmation that bills are predictable.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Sign up for free access with our perpetual free tier and 100 GB/month of data ingest included.
